scope: First maintenance PR: honest Node skip/todo/count reporting in the existing verification entry point; no business/runtime changes.

initial_github_ci.evidence: Public GitHub Actions runs/jobs API; all setup, check and cleanup steps successful. Per-test cloud counts not inspected.

before.all_skipped: Actual Node runner: tests=1, pass=0, skipped=1, exit=0; verify incorrectly reported passed
before.partial_skip: Actual Node runner: tests=2, pass=1, skipped=1, exit=0; verify incorrectly reported passed
before.new_regression_tests: Before fix: 2 test methods, 6 failed subcases and 2 missing-count errors. After fix they pass.

limits: No Linux host test; Python/Node standard library implementation is shared
No real model/browser workbench verification this round
No branch protection changes; PR creation/check still pending

iteration_observations.discovery: Review of CI result reporting led to an actual Node skip reproduction. No production issue was invented or injected.
iteration_observations.test_selection: FEATURE-MAP tooling entry identified verify/test_verify; existing 21 Python and 11 Node tooling checks were reused, then the PR ci profile ran.
iteration_observations.rework: New regressions failed once before implementation, then passed; no post-fix local failure.
iteration_observations.external_dependency: Git push authentication works, but the vault has no GitHub API credential and the current browser session is logged out; PR creation awaits login.
iteration_observations.measurement_limit: One small tooling repair cannot establish development speedup or high-volume PR reliability.

pull_request.title: 正确报告 Node 验证中的跳过与待实现项
pull_request.body:
## 变化与原因

Node 测试即使全部跳过也返回退出码 0，原验证入口因此把它显示为 passed。现在固定使用 TAP 输出并记录测试数量；部分跳过或 todo 标记 passed_with_skips，全部跳过/todo、零项或缺统计判失败。真实测试失败仍然失败，后续检查停止。

## 同步维护

- 更新功能地图中的验证结果说明和对应核对记录；三个业务流程与操作步骤未变。
- 新增真实 Node 的通过、部分跳过、部分 todo、全部跳过、全部 todo、失败六种样例，以及缺失/零项统计的回归。
- 先在旧实现复现失败，再完成修复；run tooling：21 Python、11 Node 通过。run ci：224 Python 中 220 通过、4 项 Windows 符号链接权限跳过，36 Node 通过，地图 current。
- 暂存内容导出检查确认提交不依赖无关未跟踪文件。主干首次 GitHub CI 已通过，本 PR 的自动检查需另外核对。

## 风险与回退

Node 输出固定为 TAP，日志样式会变化；跳过/todo 从纯通过改为明确状态，全部未完成会失败。沿用 Node 24 和 Python 标准库，不新增依赖或修改业务服务。Linux 本轮未实测。撤回本 PR 可恢复原报告行为。
